sources.title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
sources.snippet: We present MolmoAct2, a fully open action reasoning model built for practical deployment, advancing its predecessor along five axes. We introduce MolmoER, a VLM backbone specialized for spatial and embodied reasoning, trained on a 3.3M-sample corpus with a specialize-then-rehearse recipe.

sources.title: yugosakaguchi/smolvlalora_peginhole2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SmolVLA is a compact, efficient vision-language-action model that achieves competitive performance at reduced computational costs and can be deployed on consumer-grade hardware. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. Learn how to train and run it in the LeRobot smolvla guide, or browse the full documentation.
